Name: Dynamic Shane and Sterling
Author: Cr00kshanks
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/UnuJx1I.png[/img][/center]﻿

[center][b]This mod deals with issues of addiction, depression, and anxiety in a canon typical way.  [/b]
It also contains[b] swearing[/b] and a bit of [b]innuendo.
[/b][/center]

[center]The base of this mod is a small patch for It’s Always Raining in the Valley that makes a few dialogue changes so that if
you see Shane’s heart events before Sterling’s things continue linearly.

It optionally adds 12 new rival heart events between Shane and Sterling.
This mod continues with the themes in Always Raining in the Valley of recovery and healing.
If you enable these, sometime after seeing both Shane's 8 heart event and Sterling's platonic 10 heart event
Shane and Sterling will begin having heart events of their own, and eventually begin dating.  This is a slow burn romance.

[b]You can find the new Rival Hearts Events Guide here: [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/112Aec7ch8OmiZole_5tK36Rc2RNe-3EvaA5kKHwmkak/edit?usp=sharing]Dynamic S&S Events Guide[/url]﻿[/b][/center]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/w25jNre.png[/img]

🌼 It shouldn't break with anything, but some mods that change the map (like SVE) might result in some heart events where they walk through a solid object.
🌼 [b]Immersive Shane[/b] is compatible and highly recommended for the best play through experience.
🌼[b] [/b][b]Platonic Partners and Friends: [/b]won't break anything but if you move past 8 hearts with Sterling/move in with him and have SterlingxShane rival hearts enabled some of the events might overlap/make less sense.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/2s5ycL5.png[/img]

🌼 More lines of dialogue.
🌼 Some edits to Shane's schedule to reflect what happens in heart events.
🌼 Marriage for Shane and Sterling with additional heart events to show peaks into their life together.
🌼 Polyamory heart events between the farmer, Shane, and Sterling.

Credit to Hime for coding events 5a, 5b, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 11, the sprites added by this mod, and dialogue changes and additions. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/Ri3flAy.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/9E0eUwq.png[/img]
[/url]

🌼 [b]Hime, [/b]for creating characters with so much life in them, for letting me use your characters, helping me perfect Sterling's voice, your support and guidance in creating the mod, help coding, and the art.  It has been so much fun working on this project together I am so happy our hyper focuses aligned. 
🌼 [b]Arknir [/b]for help with modding especially with advanced move.
🌼 [b]tenthousandcats [/b]for the Immersive Characters- Shane mod.  My vision of Shane would not exist without you.
🌼 [b]Airyn[/b] for maintaining Immersive Characters- Shane, answering modding questions and everything you do for the Stardew modding community.  It would not be what it is without you.
🌼 [b]Abagaianye [/b]for answering modding questions and pretty much always being willing to look at code.
🌼 [b]Lemurkat[/b] for the ranch expansion, making creating NPCs more accessible for the modding community in general, and helping literally anyone who asks ever with modding questions. 
🌼 [b]Thylak.[/b]  I don't believe we've ever spoken but this mod would not exist without your Events for Everyone tutorial.
🌼 Everyone on the[b] East Scarp[/b] and[b] Sunberry Villag[/b]e discord servers for answering modding questions and generally being warm welcoming communities.
Thank you all so much it is such a joy to be a part of the Stardew Valley community I had so much fun creating this.
